福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

萬福庵Wanfu Temple

萬福庵藏在臺南中西區的小巷裡，是一座和明鄭歷史緊緊相連的小廟。故事從一位將軍的遺孀說起：鄭成功的水師將領阮駿在 1656 年的舟山海戰中不願投降，與戰艦同沉；他的妻子阮夫人帶著孩子跟隨鄭軍，後來渡海來臺，住在寧靖王府後方，失去獨子後吃齋念佛度過餘生。相傳明鄭覆滅後，清朝提督施琅接收了王府，阮夫人把大門改向正對施琅的住處，施琅只好在她門前砌起一道照牆擋煞。這道三百多年的照牆至今還在，牆頂中間高、兩端翹起燕尾，是列為市定古蹟的部分。阮夫人過世後，鄰里把她的住處改成寺廟紀念她，清嘉慶年間改名萬福庵；如今廟裡主祀齊天大聖，神桌上大大小小的猴王神像擠成一片，父母常帶調皮的孩子來給大聖當契子。廟前廣場還有一棵兩百多歲的「猴靈樹王公」，樹幹上一團團樹瘤，看起來就像一群攀爬的猴子。

Wanfu Temple hides in a small lane in Tainan's West Central District, and its story goes back to the Ming loyalist era. In 1656, Ruan Jun, one of Koxinga's naval commanders, went down with his ship rather than surrender. His widow, Madame Ruan, followed the Zheng army to Taiwan and lived behind Prince Ningjing's palace, where she spent her last years as a vegetarian chanting sutras after her only son died. Legend says that when the Qing admiral Shi Lang took over the palace, she turned her door to face his home, so he built a screen wall in front of it to block the bad energy. That wall, more than three hundred years old, still stands, with swallowtail ends curling up on top, and it is the part listed as a monument. After her death, neighbors turned her home into a temple, and it later took the name Wanfu An. Today it honors the Monkey King, and parents bring naughty children to become his godchildren. In the square stands a tree over two hundred years old, whose knobbly trunk looks like a troop of climbing monkeys.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 將軍與遺孀故事從 1656 年、浙江外海的舟山群島說起。The story begins in 1656, off the Zhoushan Islands.
  2. 風水對決1683 年明鄭覆滅，故事進入最有名的一段。In 1683, the Ming loyalist cause collapsed.
  3. 猴子廟阮夫人過世後，鄰里把宅邸改為「阮夫人寺」紀念她。After her death, neighbors turned her home into a temple.

認識景點

About the place

將軍與遺孀The general and the widow

水師將領阮駿：阮駿是鄭成功麾下的水師將領。 與艦同沉：1656 年舟山海戰，他不願投降，引爆船上火藥，與艦同沉。 渡海來臺：遺孀帶著獨子跟著鄭軍；1664 年隨鄭經撤退來臺。 王府後的家：鄭氏禮遇忠烈之後，在寧靖王府後方為她安宅。

Naval commander Ruan Jun: Ruan Jun commanded warships for Koxinga. Down with his ship: In 1656, rather than surrender, he set off his ship's gunpowder. Across the sea: His widow followed the Zheng army and came to Taiwan in 1664. A home behind the palace: The Zheng court gave her a home behind Prince Ningjing's palace.

獨子病逝：不久，她唯一的兒子也病逝了。 吃齋唸佛：失去一切的阮夫人，在這裡吃齋唸佛，度過餘生。

Her only son: Soon her only son fell ill and died. A quiet life: She lived out her days here as a vegetarian, chanting sutras.

風水對決A feng shui duel

施琅提督：得勝的清朝提督施琅接收了寧靖王府，就是今天的大天后宮。 大門改朝西：相傳阮夫人把大門從朝南改成朝西，直直對準施琅的住處。 煞氣：風水認為正對的門會帶來「煞氣」。 照牆：相傳施琅在她門前築起照牆，擋住煞氣。

Admiral Shi Lang: The Qing admiral Shi Lang took over the palace, today's Grand Matsu Temple. A door turned west: Legend says she turned her door to aim straight at Shi Lang's home. Killing breath: In feng shui, a door pointed at you sends out bad energy. screen wall: The story says Shi Lang built a screen wall to block it.

雙重脊與燕尾：磚造抹白灰，牆頂中央高、兩側低，都翹著燕尾。 古蹟是那道牆：廟在 1972 年改建，列為市定古蹟的是三百多年的照牆。

Double ridge, swallowtails: The center of the ridge is higher, and every end curls up like a swallow's tail. The wall is the monument: The temple was rebuilt in 1972, so the listed monument is the old wall.

猴子廟The Monkey King temple

改名萬福庵：1806 年（清嘉慶年間）改為今名「萬福庵」。 育嬰的傳說：相傳阮夫人以育嬰為生，供奉齊天大聖，讓哭鬧的孩子好教。 齊天大聖：一樓供奉大大小小數十尊猴神像；神桌上的石雕大聖據說最古老。 樓上的觀音：廟方說這不是位階高低：大聖是奉觀音之命下凡助人。

Renamed Wanfu An: In 1806, it took its present name, Wanfu An. The babysitting legend: Tradition says she cared for babies and prayed to the Monkey King to calm them. Monkey King: Dozens of monkey statues fill the ground floor. Guanyin upstairs: The temple says Guanyin sent the Monkey King to help people.

猴靈樹王公：照牆旁的老榕，樹瘤像群猴攀爬，至今仍有人上香。 給大聖當契子：這裡被稱為全臺齊天大聖的開基祖廟；父母會帶調皮孩子來當契子。

Monkey-Spirit Tree King: The old banyan's burls look like climbing monkeys. The Great Sage's godchildren: Parents bring naughty children to become the Monkey King's godchildren.

實景照片

Photos on site

萬福庵照牆 The screen wall

這道白牆就是列為市定古蹟的萬福庵照牆，已有三百多年。牆頂中間高、兩邊低，每一端都翹起燕尾，彩繪已經斑駁。左邊的石柱刻著「萬福庵照牆」。

This white wall is the Wanfu Temple screen wall, more than three hundred years old and a city monument. Its top is higher in the middle, and every end curls up like a swallow's tail. The stone post on the left carries its name.

走進萬福庵 Into the temple

從門口往裡看：紅柱上刻著金字對聯，地上鋪著六角形的紅磚，最裡面就是供奉齊天大聖的神桌。

Look in from the door. Gold couplets cover the red pillars, the floor has six-sided red tiles, and the Monkey King's altar is at the very back.

齊天大聖的神桌 The Monkey King's altar

神桌上擠滿大大小小的神像，正中間戴著華麗帽冠的就是齊天大聖。上方的匾寫著「普渡眾生」，左右兩邊分別供奉福德正神（土地公）和註生娘娘。

The altar is crowded with statues. The Monkey King sits in the middle, wearing a fancy crown. The board above means saving all living beings. On the sides are the Earth God and the goddess who protects mothers and babies.

戟與磬：吉慶 A halberd and a chime

門邊的彩繪：一位將軍拿著戟，小孩手捧磬。「戟磬」唸起來像「吉慶」，祝福大家吉祥喜慶。

In this painting by the door, a general holds a halberd and a child holds a bowl-shaped chime. Said together in Chinese, the two names sound like good luck and celebration.

旗與球：祈求 A flag and a ball

另一邊的彩繪：將軍揮著寫有「祈求吉祥」的旗子，小孩提著一顆球。「旗球」唸起來像「祈求」，就是向神明祈求好運。

In the matching painting, a general waves a flag and a child carries a ball. The words flag and ball sound like the Chinese word for praying for something.

大聖生日的花圈 Birthday wreaths

齊天大聖生日（聖誕千秋）時，各地宮廟和信徒會送來祝賀的花圈，紅色圓心上寫著「恭祝齊天大聖聖誕千秋」。

For the Monkey King's birthday, other temples and worshippers send big flower wreaths. The red centers carry birthday greetings to the Great Sage.

猴靈樹王公 The Monkey-Spirit Tree

廟前廣場上這棵大樹被尊稱為「猴靈樹王公」，樹下圍著紅色欄杆、綁著紅布。

The big tree in the square is honored as the Monkey-Spirit Tree King. A red fence and red cloth surround its trunk.

長得像猴子的樹幹 The monkey-shaped trunk

靠近看猴靈樹王公：樹幹由許多氣根纏在一起，扭成一團團樹瘤。廟方說，這些樹瘤看起來像一群攀爬的猴子。

Up close, the trunk is made of many roots twisted together into knobs. The temple says these knobs look like a troop of climbing monkeys.

樹王公的木牌 The tree's wooden sign

木牌上寫著：這棵樹有兩百多年歷史，得到大聖的靈氣，樹瘤漸漸長成猴子的樣子，所以取名「猴靈樹」。木牌是萬福庵在民國癸酉年（1993 年）立的。仔細看樹幹，你看得出猴子嗎？

The wooden sign says the tree is over two hundred years old. Touched by the Monkey King's spirit, its knobbly trunk grew into the shapes of monkeys. The temple put up the sign in 1993. Look closely at the trunk. Can you spot the monkeys?
